name: jev-copilot
description: TypeSafe JEV via OpenRouter as a fast, typed System-1 decision layer for Claude Code: task routing, context ranking, completion review and tool-risk triage.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used only by the local JEV runtime to call the OpenRouter Decisions API. Stored in your OS credential store. Leave empty to fall back to the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable or to the key saved by `/jev-copilot:configure`.

mode.title: JEV Copilot mode
mode.description: assist = advisory only; enhance = automatic analysis + completion review (default); strict = tighter thresholds and fail-closed gates.

jev_model.title: JEV model
jev_model.description: OpenRouter model id. Keep the pinned default for calibrated thresholds; ~typesafe/jev-latest tracks the newest release and may shift behavior.

completion_review_enabled.title: Completion review
completion_review_enabled.description: Run a JEV completion review when Claude stops after making changes (enhance/strict modes).

tool_governance_enabled.title: High-impact tool governance
tool_governance_enabled.description: Add JEV semantic review to high-impact tool calls after deterministic classification. Read-only tools are never sent to JEV.

session_budget_usd.title: Session JEV budget (USD)
session_budget_usd.description: Optional JEV calls stop once the estimated session spend exceeds this amount. 0 disables the budget.

deep_model.title: YouTube research deep model
deep_model.description: Deep-analysis layer for the YouTube research engine: claude-session (default; Claude synthesizes from the cited evidence bundle) or an OpenRouter chat model id such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 for headless runs.
